instruction: Move forward toward the tall, rectangular tower positioned at the center of the scene—its stepped base rising in tiers, its smooth light-gray shaft lined with dark-framed windows glowing with warm orange light, and its flat-topped crown slightly wider and darker than the main structure. The building’s clean, blocky silhouette, accented by arched windows along the base, stands out sharply against its surroundings. Once you reach it, come to a stop.

Begin by moving forward toward the center of the scene, where you’ll encounter a multi-story rectangular building with a flat roof and light gray or pale blue-gray walls. Its windows form a neat grid—large arched ones on the lower floors with dark frames and blinds, and smaller rectangular windows above. A prominent billboard sits atop the roof, advertising with text and a figure in blue, while a smaller oval sign is mounted on the right side near the street. Below, wide arched openings suggest entrances or storefronts, flanked by potted plants, a bench, and a streetlamp near the corner—its lines crisp and roof unadorned.

Then, turn right and proceed forward again, now approaching another substantial multi-story structure. This one bears a weathered gray facade, defined by thick concrete or stone beams forming a grid across its surface. Its upper windows are rectangular with arched tops, while lower ones are simpler rectangles, many darkened or showing blinds. A stepped, pyramidal roof section crowns the center, supporting a tall metal antenna tower with cross-braced elements and horizontal arrays. The main roof is flat and dark, extending outward into a wide overhang, while the building’s base is slightly recessed, casting a shadow. Vertical pilasters frame the corners, and the walls show signs of age—rough texture, discoloration, and subtle staining.

Finally, come to a stop.

Move forward down the street until you reach a dark gray brick building with a flat roof, lined with rectangular windows, a black metal fire escape on its right side, and a large light-colored billboard on the left — its entrance marked by black metal stairs leading to a dark door. Then, turn right to face a corner view of a multi-story beige stone building, its facade detailed with recessed windows framed in dark brown, a decorative cornice along the top, and one striking red-lit window on the second floor from the bottom; notice how its sharp corner and long shadow stretch across the pavement ahead. Finally, come to a stop and take in the full scene before you.

Start by moving forward down the street, keeping your gaze centered on the red-brick building ahead—its flat roof edged with a crenellated parapet, its facade lined with dark-framed windows in a neat grid, and a black fire escape climbing vertically from ground to rooftop. On the right, a large advertisement poster stands out against the brick, while below, two wooden benches flank a stoop leading to a doorway, with a street sign and lamppost marking the corner.

Then, turn right and continue forward. As you advance, shift your focus upward to the top-center of your view—there, another multi-story brick building rises, its reddish-brown walls accented by light gray stone trim forming horizontal bands and vertical corner details. Rectangular windows, some revealing red curtains or blinds, punctuate the facade, and a black fire escape clings to its side, connecting landings with railings and stair sections. The roof mirrors the structure below, capped with a low parapet of matching brick and stone. Beneath it all, a paved sidewalk stretches out, lined with a solitary lamppost and a wooden bench.

Begin by moving forward toward the bottom center of the scene, where you’ll find a rectangular, dark-gray building with a flat roof and a colorful billboard atop it. Its facade is neatly divided into three horizontal tiers of windows — rectangular on top, arched in the middle, and a mix at street level — all framed in dark tones, some glowing softly from within. A small bench, two potted plants, and a streetlamp line the sidewalk nearby. Then, turn right and proceed forward again, ascending slightly to face another multi-story structure with a similarly weathered dark-gray exterior. This building features a grid of thick mullions, recessed windows — arched above and rectangular below — and sturdy vertical pilasters at its corners. Crowning its roof is a raised platform supporting a tall metallic telecommunications tower bristling with antennas. Once you’ve taken in this view, come to a stop.

Head forward down the path until you reach a light blue-gray building with a flat facade, grid-patterned windows, and a red horizontal band just above the ground-floor storefronts — it’s centered directly ahead. Then, turn right and continue walking until you arrive at a tall, dark gray structure with a stark, geometric design — its surface is covered in a uniform grid of windows, framed in dark trim, and topped by a flat roof with a slightly stepped upper section set back from the main face. Once you’ve reached this building, come to a stop.

Move forward down the path until you reach the large rectangular building with a dark gray, textured facade—its blocky, multi-story form capped by a flat, slightly stepped roofline adorned with mechanical units and a prominent yellow billboard with red and white lettering. As you approach, notice the grid of arched windows framed in light trim, many with red or dark shades behind them, and the decorative horizontal moldings that divide the facade. The ground floor features larger arched openings and a set of steps leading to the main entrance, with a small dark bench resting on the sidewalk just ahead. Once you arrive, stop and take in the scene.

Head straight ahead toward the tall, light-gray building with a flat roof lined by small dark structures, its facade marked by a neat grid of dark-framed windows and ground-level storefronts—one bearing a red sign, the other a green awning—with a small flat-roofed extension crowning the top. Then, turn right and continue forward to reach the imposing dark-gray structure shaped like a stepped pyramid, its tiers receding upward in clean horizontal lines, its surface clad in textured stone or concrete and covered in uniformly dark, recessed windows framed by slender mullions. Once you’ve arrived, come to a stop.

Move forward down the path until you reach the center of the scene, where a stately rectangular building stands with a flat roof and a uniform dark blue-gray facade. Its roofline is adorned with a decorative cornice of evenly spaced rectangular blocks, and its windows form a neat grid—arched on the upper floors with white frames and red curtains peeking through, rectangular on the ground floor. In front, a sidewalk hosts a black lamppost, a blue trash can, and two black benches, while a small leafy tree adds a touch of green to the left foreground. Once you’ve arrived at this point, come to a stop.

Move forward down the street until you reach the center of the scene, where a stately rectangular brick building stands—its reddish-brown walls accented by light gray stone trim around the windows and along the roofline. Neat rows of dark-framed windows line the facade, while black metal fire escapes climb the street-facing side from the second floor upward. A central entrance, flanked by concrete steps and black railings, invites approach, and two wooden benches rest on the sidewalk nearby. To the left, a glowing yellow streetlamp casts a warm glow, and a small tree with green leaves and yellow blossoms peeks into view from the lower right, softening the urban edge. Once you’ve arrived at this point, come to a gentle stop.

Move forward toward the center of the scene, where a multi-part building stands prominently — its light beige main facade contrasted by a darker gray wing to the right. The front is lined with tall, narrow windows capped with rounded tops and framed in reddish-brown, beneath a flat, light gray roof dotted with small vents and crowned by a large, dome-shaped structure. Rising from the dome is a slender metal antenna tower, fitted with crossbars and equipment boxes. To the right, the darker gray section features grand arched windows above and rectangular ones below, with a sloped, dark blue metal roof peeking out behind. At ground level, dark awnings shade the windows, set against a solid dark gray base.

Begin by moving forward toward the bottom center of the scene, where a dark blue-gray rectangular building stands with a flat roof and a grid of black-framed windows—six rows high and five columns wide. Notice the ground-floor storefronts: one with a red awning, a plain dark entrance in the middle, and another with a green awning, while a small box-like structure rests near the roof’s center. Then, make a sharp right turn and continue straight ahead. You’ll soon approach another building—this one made of gray stone or concrete, also rectangular with a flat roof, but featuring a decorative cornice and a parapet with recessed patterns. Its windows vary: arched on top with red-tinted glass, rectangular below with white frames and shutters, and its corners subtly突出. A tree with vibrant yellow-green leaves partially hides the lower right side. Finally, come to a complete stop.

Move forward until you reach the tall, rectangular tower standing prominently at the center of the view — its stepped base rises in three tiers, the main shaft clad in dark gray with a grid of small windows, crowned by a square section with a domed roof and a pointed finial. The wider base features lighter gray stone and large recessed windows, lending the structure a symmetrical, imposing presence with clean, sharp lines. Once you arrive, stop.

Begin by moving forward toward the bottom center of the scene, where you’ll encounter a rectangular, block-like building with a flat roof and a muted blue-gray facade. Notice the decorative parapet along the roofline, the grid of evenly spaced windows across six floors, and the three ground-floor storefronts—each topped with a distinct sign: red with white text on the left, dark and blank in the middle, and green with white text on the right. A small mechanical unit sits near the roof’s center.

Then, turn right and proceed forward to center yourself before a towering, dark gray structure. This building rises with a stepped silhouette, each upper level receding slightly from the one below. Its surface is dominated by a dense, cage-like pattern of recessed windows divided by thin mullions, framed by thick horizontal bands that protrude subtly from the facade. The topmost section is narrowest, capped with a flat, slightly overhanging roof—giving the entire structure a monolithic, rhythmically textured presence.

Finally, come to a halt and take in the full view.

Begin by moving forward toward the tall, rectangular building with a dark gray facade and stepped-back roofline, where illuminated windows cast a warm glow against the otherwise shadowed grid. As you approach, turn left and continue walking forward down the path, where you’ll encounter another imposing structure—this one clad in gray stone, featuring a blocky tower form, flat roof with decorative parapets, and paired windows across its floors, some arched with blinds, others rectangular with curtains. A bare tree stands to the right, and a red telephone booth waits on the left sidewalk near its central entrance.

Move forward down the street until you reach a reddish-brown brick building with a flat roof, decorative cornice, and a black metal fire escape running along its right side—windows are dark-framed and aligned in vertical rows, with a small gated entrance at ground level and a curved streetlamp standing nearby. Then, make a sharp right turn and come to a stop in front of a tall, dark gray structure featuring a textured facade, a brick chimney at the top left, and a fire escape clinging to its left side. Its windows display hints of color from inside, and a small dark box rests on the sidewalk below. Pause here to take in the scene.

Begin by moving forward down the street, keeping your gaze centered on the imposing multi-story building ahead—its dark gray, weathered facade rising in a rectangular block, crowned by a stepped roofline that supports a glowing billboard. Notice the grid of windows: rectangular on top, arched below, with black mullions framing each pane. At ground level, arched entryways with glass and metal grilles welcome you, flanked by potted plants and a small streetlamp. After taking in the details, turn right, then proceed forward again, ascending slightly as you approach another grand structure—this one gray and equally weathered, its flat roof punctuated by a dome and antenna array. Its facade is defined by a strong grid of windows, arched above and rectangular below, framed by thick concrete mullions and reinforced corners, all under a slightly overhanging roof with dark trim. Pause here, having traced the path from one architectural landmark to the next.

Move forward toward the large, multi-story building with dark gray, textured walls and a grid of tall, arched windows framed in lighter tones—its flat roof lined with a decorative parapet and a vertical sign with gold lettering near the base. Then, turn left to face the adjacent street scene: on your left, a light gray brick building with arched upper windows and dark metal grilles, separated by a lighter stone band; on your right, a darker gray structure with rectangular windows, a black fire escape, and a red awning over a ground-floor entrance, with a streetlamp standing sentinel on the sidewalk. Come to a stop and take in the full view.

Start by moving forward down toward the bottom center of the scene, where you’ll find a multi-story gray building with a rectangular shape and flat roof. Its windows form a neat grid, some arched on upper floors, and a black fire escape runs vertically along its side. Ground-level display windows are topped with red signage, while interior lights and green objects peek through upper windows. From there, turn left and continue straight ahead until you reach the center of the view — there, a tall brick building rises, its dark reddish-brown facade trimmed with light gray stone. A bold yellow sign with a red oval reading “Sun Moon” in white cursive dominates the front, flanked by “Drink” above and “Served Ice Cold” below. At its base, a black metal bench sits on the sidewalk, flanked by small grated openings near the ground.

Move forward toward the center of the scene, where a stately building stands with a dark gray rectangular facade. Its most striking feature is the large, rounded dome at the roof’s center, crowned by a metal antenna array, flanked by two smaller, dark-sloped roof sections. The windows form a neat grid—rectangular on the upper floors, arched at ground level—with a black streetlamp positioned along the sidewalk in front. Once you reach it, come to a stop.

Move forward down the path until you reach a light gray rectangular building with a flat dark gray roof, tall arched windows framed in reddish-brown, and ground-level openings covered by dark grilles—some shaded by small awnings, with pink-umbrellaed tables arranged on the paved front area. Then, turn left to face a tall, dark blue-gray structure defined by horizontal bands, crowned with three large arched windows separated by vertical pillars. Below, vertical columns of rectangular windows with dark frames and partially open blinds reveal glimpses of colorful interiors, while pilasters reinforce its corners and a subtle cornice lines the overhanging flat roof. Stop here and take in the full view.

Move forward until you reach the center of the scene, where a substantial rectangular building stands—its facade clad in light gray stone or concrete, punctuated by vertical columns of dark-framed windows, some glowing softly from within. Below, the ground floor is anchored by large, dark arched openings, while a low, flat-roofed annex extends from the front corner, echoing the arches and capped with a dark roof. The roofline remains clean and unembellished, rising to a small antenna or mast at its peak. Once you arrive, come to a complete stop.

Head straight down the street until you reach the muted blue-gray building with a flat roof and crenellated parapet—its ground floor hosts “Lambert’s Restaurant & Bar” on the left and “THE SWEET SHOP” under a green awning on the right, both framed by a dark horizontal band above. Then, turn right and continue forward to arrive at the tall, dark gray structure with a stepped-back upper level, its facade lined with grid-like windows and accented by protruding horizontal bands, capped by a wide overhanging cornice. Stop once you’ve reached this building.

Begin by moving forward down the street, keeping your gaze centered on the imposing rectangular building ahead—its light gray brick facade, flat roof lined with small protruding blocks, and vertical black fire escapes creating a striking urban rhythm. As you approach, notice the grid of dark-framed windows and the two ground-level entrances flanked by short staircases, with a small dark red phone booth nestled on the pavement nearby. Then, make a sharp right turn, pivoting smoothly to face a new direction. Continue moving forward up the next street, where a tall, sleek structure rises before you—its uniform light gray stone or concrete surface punctuated by a precise grid of vertically aligned windows, smaller on the lower floors and expanding upward, crowned by a modest square vent near the roof’s center. To your right, a glimpse of an ornate neighboring building with arched windows adds contrast, but your focus remains on the clean, unadorned lines of the main structure. Finally, come to a gentle stop, taking in the full presence of the building before you.

Move forward toward the tall, rectangular building with a light gray stone-like facade—its vertical tower capped by a flat roof, featuring a small chimney stack on the right and antennas on the left, all framed by dark-trimmed edges. As you approach, notice the grid of large, dark-framed windows glowing softly with interior lights, and below, the grand arched entrances flanked by thick stone pillars, sheltered under dark sloped awnings. A solitary streetlamp stands on the sidewalk just before the entrance. Once you’ve reached the center of the scene, come to a stop.

Head straight ahead until you reach the tall, light-gray building with horizontal banding and dark-brown-framed windows—its lower right corner is gently veiled by a small, leafy green tree. Then, turn right and continue forward until you arrive at the dark-gray, multi-story structure featuring a prominent black fire escape, grid-like windows (some revealing glimpses of interiors like a red curtain), and a recessed ground-floor entrance with three vertical panels. To its right, you’ll notice outdoor seating on the sidewalk, and beyond it, a taller, light-colored building with a tower-like silhouette looms in the distance. Once there, come to a stop.

Move forward toward the center of the scene, where you’ll find a striking building with a blocky, rectangular form—its front clad in light beige with tall, arched windows framed in dark trim, while the side reveals a darker gray facade lined with rectangular windows. Above, a flat roof hosts small square chimney-like structures, crowned by a large dark gray dome, which in turn supports a slender metallic mast with horizontal crossbars. At ground level, a dark awning shelters what appears to be a storefront. Once you’ve reached it, come to a stop.

Head straight ahead until you reach a tall, gray rectangular building with a flat roof—its facade is marked by a grid of windows, arched on the upper floors and rectangular below, with a vertical line of small dark dots down the center. Atop the roof, you’ll spot a metal framework and a smaller box-like structure. Then, make a sharp left turn and continue forward until you come upon a light beige building featuring recessed windows framed in dark brown, each with partially open horizontal blinds casting striped shadows. The upper windows are crowned with arched concrete lintels, and the roof is flat and broad, edged by a thick dark brown parapet. Rising from the roof is a rounded dome, also beige, crowned by a tall black metal antenna tower fitted with cross-braced sections and satellite dishes. Once you’ve reached this point, come to a complete stop.

Move forward down the street until you reach the long rectangular building with a flat, light-colored roof and brown brick walls—its facade lined with rows of dark-framed windows, black metal fire escapes, and a set of stairs leading to a dark entrance flanked by railings. A streetlamp and bench sit on the sidewalk in front, while small box-like structures dot the roof. Then, turn left to face another similar structure: a reddish-brown brick building with gray stone accents, a prominent fire escape, and rectangular windows some of which show blinds or curtains. On its roof near the rear sits a small square gray structure, and at ground level, you’ll find a concrete sidewalk with a black metal bench, a streetlamp, and stairs with black railings leading to the main entrance. Come to a stop here and take in the scene.

Move forward toward the center of the scene, where a multi-story, blocky rectangular building stands at a corner angle, revealing two of its facades. Its exterior is clad in a uniform dark gray or bluish-gray tone, punctuated by a dense grid of white- or light-gray-framed windows—arched on the upper floors, rectangular below. A flat roof with a subtle parapet edge crowns the structure, and a small boxy mechanical unit perches at the top corner. The building rests on a light gray paved base, flanked along its ground floor by small, dark bench-like elements on both visible sides.

Move forward down the street until you reach a striking red-brick building with a flat dark-gray roof, a black metal fire escape running up its left side, and a large yellow-and-white billboard with red text on the right. Notice the evenly spaced rectangular windows, the recessed entrance with black railings and steps, the potted plants lining the sidewalk, and the two wooden benches near the door — a streetlamp with a red sign stands to the right. Then, make a sharp right turn and pause to take in the adjacent structure: a light-brown brick building accented with horizontal gray stone bands, featuring wooden-framed windows — some lit warmly from within — and a crisscross-patterned fire escape climbing its facade. Its flat roof is edged with a matching parapet, and concrete steps with black handrails lead down to a shadowed entryway, with the fire escape continuing upward beyond view. Hold your position here for a moment to absorb the scene.

Move forward down the path toward the large rectangular building situated at the center of the scene — its gray facade rises with orderly rows of windows, arched above and rectangular below, each framed by subtle decorative borders. A bold cornice crowns the structure, lined with evenly spaced rectangular blocks, while vertical pilasters accentuate its corners from ground to roof. Atop the flat roof, a freestanding billboard with a yellow background and red circular logo stands out. Below, a recessed entrance features a dark arched doorway flanked by two large rectangular windows, and along the sidewalk, small planters with lush green shrubs soften the urban edge.

Move forward toward the large, multi-story building situated at the center of the scene — its imposing, blocky form clad in dark gray stone or concrete, punctuated by a dense grid of tall, arched windows framed in white. A decorative cornice crowns the structure just beneath its flat roof, which hosts an array of vents and small chimneys. The building rises from a raised paved platform, accessible via a short flight of stairs leading to its ground-floor entrance.

Move forward toward the large, multi-story building positioned at the center of the view — its dark gray, blocky form rises with a dense grid of windows, rectangular below and arched above, capped by a flat roof lined with a decorative cornice and dotted with mechanical units and a slender antenna. Its slightly rounded corners lend it a solid, imposing presence. Once you’ve reached it, come to a stop.

Move forward toward the center of the scene, where a towering skyscraper rises with a stepped, tiered base that gradually narrows as it ascends. Its sleek, dark gray facade is marked by a precise grid of rectangular windows, uninterrupted except for the crown—a segmented dome capped with a slender spire. Just below the dome, a boxy section features small square windows, while the broader base, also windowed, steps back slightly before the main tower begins. Keep your path centered as you approach this imposing, minimalist structure.

Begin by moving forward, heading downward, toward the large, multi-story building centered in your view — its light gray, stone-like facade rises in a rectangular block, punctuated by a grid of tall, white-framed windows and accented with red frames on lower levels. Horizontal bands with dotted textures separate each floor, and the flat roof is edged with a matching parapet. A covered entrance, supported by four thick columns, marks the ground level, while its slightly rounded corner features arched windows. In the distance, a smaller, older structure with a metal antenna peeks into view.

Then, turn left and continue moving forward, descending again toward another prominent building — this one also multi-storied and rectangular, with a sharp, angled corner facing you. Its light gray, textured surface is segmented by dark horizontal bands, and its flat roof is lined with a decorative parapet featuring recessed rectangles and small, evenly spaced vents. Windows with dark frames fill the facade, some with shutters or reddish-brown reflections, while the ground floor holds larger windows and a recessed doorway. A strong shadow stretches across its lower right side, cast by sunlight from the upper left.

Finally, come to a stop.

Move forward until you reach the center of the scene, where a towering skyscraper stands prominently — its stepped base rising into a slender central tower, clad in a grid of dark recessed windows framed by lighter mullions. At its crown, a compact square section topped with a thin antenna catches the sunlight, which casts sharp shadows across its matte, textured facade. A faded billboard adorns the lower portion of the base, all set against a bright, clear sky. Then, come to a complete stop.

Head straight down toward the center of the scene, where you’ll find a tall, dark gray brick building marked by vertical pilasters, a grid of windows, and a blue “MARKET” billboard atop its flat roof—flanked by stone steps, planters, and a lamppost. Then, make a sharp left turn and proceed upward to the top center, where a striking light beige tower rises in three tiered sections: a wide base with arched windows, a midsection of uniform rectangular windows, and a slender spire-like top—all capped with a clean, flat roof and defined by sharp vertical lines. Finally, come to a complete stop.

Move forward toward the center of the scene, where you’ll find a towering rectangular structure with a dark, uniform exterior. Its face is patterned with a dense grid of small, square windows that form a striking checkerboard effect across all visible sides. The building rises in two distinct vertical tiers — a broader base that narrows as it ascends, separated by a lighter horizontal band adorned with a decorative railing. At its crown, a flat, slightly recessed roofline supports a small, boxy, dark structure centered atop. The entire edifice is rendered in deep gray to black tones, subtly modulated by light, with the nearly black windows sharply contrasting against the faintly lighter window frames. Once you reach it, come to a stop.

Begin by moving forward toward the tall, light-gray building with a flat, stepped roof—its facade lined with vertical columns of windows, some arched above and rectangular below, with subtle textures and a narrow vertical strip along the corner; a small dark bench sits near its base. Then, make a sharp left turn and proceed downward, heading toward the reddish-brown brick structure ahead, distinguished by its gray stone trim, diagonal fire escape, grid-patterned windows, decorative cornice, and rooftop mechanical units; two staircases with railings lead to its entrances, and a wooden bench rests on the sidewalk nearby. Finally, come to a complete stop.

Begin by moving forward toward the bottom center of the scene, where a tall, rectangular building with a flat roof and uniform gray exterior stands. Its facade is lined with a precise grid of dark-framed windows, revealing glimpses of warm interior hues—browns, reds, and blues—while five arched windows grace its wider base. Mechanical units and a satellite dish dot the rooftop, and sharp vertical lines accentuate its clean, defined corners. Then, make a sharp left turn and proceed forward again, ascending toward another towering structure—this one stepped and tapering toward the top, clad in light gray brick. Its vertical bands of large, dark-framed windows reflect glowing orange and brown interior lights. Near the base, a projecting section displays three arched windows per level, framed in smooth, lighter material. The roof is flat, crowned by a small square structure and a slender spire, with the uppermost tier featuring recessed windows and a subtly darker, textured finish.

Move forward until you reach the center of the scene, where a substantial rectangular building with a flat roof stands prominently. Its dark gray façade is punctuated by vertical rows of windows—tall and arched on the upper levels, wider and barred on the ground floor. A bold red-and-yellow billboard adorns the left side of the roof, while two classic red phone booths sit neatly on the sidewalk below. Along the roofline, a low parapet runs its length, and small mechanical units are visible atop the roof. Once you arrive, come to a complete stop.

Move forward toward the bottom center of the scene, where a gray-brick building stands with a flat roof, grid-patterned windows, and a black metal fire escape climbing its right side — a faded billboard adorns its left, and two stair-led entrances sit at ground level, flanked by a lamppost bearing a red-and-white sign. Then, turn right to face a pair of adjacent structures: on the right, a light beige brick building with dark-framed windows crowned by triangular pediments and a dark parapet along its roofline; to the left, a narrower reddish-brown brick structure featuring a tall vertical poster, a recessed doorway, and a dark grate near its base — both buildings share flat roofs and a quiet urban presence. Finally, come to a halt and take in the full view.

Move forward toward the tall, rectangular building situated at the center of the view—its light gray facade marked by vertical lines and a grid of dark-framed windows, some gently arched on upper levels. A small dark awning shelters the ground-floor entrance, while the flat roof is edged by a low parapet and topped with a modest mechanical unit.

Head downward toward the bottom center of the scene, where you’ll find a blocky, dark blue-gray building with a stepped-back upper level, flat roof dotted with mechanical units, and vertical rows of dark-framed windows—some broken—alongside a red neon sign at the corner and a fire escape on the right. Then, pivot left and proceed upward to reach a tall, rectangular tower with a grid of recessed windows framed by light gray panels, vertical pilasters at its corners, and a weathered facade showing stains and discoloration; its base features arched windows and a distinct cornice, while a small antenna-like structure crowns the roof. Once there, come to a halt.

Move forward down the street until you reach a large, multi-story building with a dark gray, textured stone or concrete facade, featuring a strict grid of tall rectangular windows—some arched at the top—with white frames. Notice the decorative molding along the roofline and the vertical orange sign near the corner on the right-facing side; at ground level, arched entryways and potted plants line the sidewalk. Then, turn left to face a neighboring structure: a rectangular building with a flat roof, light gray textured walls, and darker gray trim around its vertically aligned windows—some of which show red or green panes. Above the ground-floor entrance, a red sign with white lettering stands out, and a small overhang extends from the second floor on the left. The entrance itself has a curved top and is flanked by a large window. Once you’ve taken in these details, come to a complete stop.

Begin by moving forward down the street, keeping your gaze centered on the tall, rectangular building ahead—its dark gray facade rising vertically, punctuated by a grid of windows with reddish-brown and blue-tinted panes. Notice the large, light-colored billboard mounted mid-level, featuring a portrait and text, while below, three arched windows frame the ground floor, and a small mechanical structure sits atop the flat roof. As you approach, make a sharp left turn, then continue straight ahead. Ahead now, another multi-story structure comes into view—its uniform dark gray panels and grid of rectangular windows, some with horizontal blinds, define its face. A bright, illuminated billboard displays imagery and text along its side, while a green metal antenna rises from the flat roof’s edge and a small red awning shelters the entrance below. When you reach this point, come to a complete stop.

Move forward until you reach the tall, rectangular building with a dark gray, textured facade—its flat roof adorned with a decorative, evenly spaced vertical pattern along the edge. Notice how its windows form a grid: rectangular on the lower floors, arched above, and how the upper section steps back to create a tiered silhouette. A small, dark tree stands in the foreground to the left. Once you’ve arrived at this landmark, come to a stop.

Move forward until you reach the long, reddish-brown brick building with dark-framed windows stretching across its facade, a black metal fire escape climbing its right side, and a flat roof dotted with mechanical units. At its base, two sets of concrete stairs lead up to dark doors, while a small leafy tree peeks into view from the left foreground. Then, turn left to face the adjacent side of the same structure — a multi-story block with gray stone trim outlining its corners and windows, a crenellated parapet crowning its flat roof, and a boxy rooftop feature near the center. Here, the fire escape continues its ascent along the street-facing wall, flanked by ground-level entrances with black handrails and steps. A wooden bench with a black metal frame rests on the sidewalk, and near the base, lighter gray brickwork and small arched vents complete the scene. Come to a stop and take in the full view.

Head forward toward the tall, rectangular building with a flat gray facade, its surface defined by a grid of recessed windows framed in dark material—some with blinds, others glowing or reflecting light. Notice the sharp architectural lines and the slightly protruding section on the right, featuring glass panels and metal railings that suggest a balcony. After reaching it, turn right and continue straight ahead to arrive at another tall, rectangular structure with a light gray textured exterior. This one features a diagonal black fire escape climbing its front, arched windows with black frames—some tinted red or green—and a dark blue awning over the ground-floor entrance, emblazoned with “GROCERY & DELI GOODS” in yellow letters.
